categories.label: G1 skills & BATON sequences
categories.description: The flagship G1 robotics demos (walk, carry, turn, climb). RUN THESE FROM A SHELL, NOT THE LAUNCH BUTTON: each needs a large deploy env (engine hook + ghost LUTs + corridors + harness + BATON course) that a bare world load cannot carry — clicking Launch opens the scene but shows a LIFELESS robot. Every blurb below gives the bash one-liner. Catalogue CLI: python projects/policies/skills/skill_lib.py list (15 skills + 6 BATON sequences). HARNESS DISCLOSURE: rows marked CRANED run on a weight-bearing puppet harness (up to 700 N up ~= 2x the 34 kg G1's weight, +/-350 N.m attitude) — a real-footwork but NOT free-standing walk. The stair climb is the exception: HARNESS_KZ=0, the legs do the lifting. Details + honest status: DEMOS.md section 2.

demos.name: G1 box delivery (BATON headliner)
demos.blurb: RUN: bash projects/policies/demos/run_box_delivery.sh  — G1 walks to cart A, picks a real 1.5 kg box, carries it to cart B, sets it down on real contact, takes a real ~90-deg footwork corner, walks away. 0 falls. CRANED. Corner certified only in the 0->90 deg band.

demos.name: G1 box delivery — classic
demos.blurb: RUN: bash projects/policies/demos/run_box_delivery_classic.sh  — the verified baseline delivery: walk, stand, pick the real 1.5 kg box, carry, place, walk on, stand. 0 falls, no corner. CRANED.

demos.name: G1 walk -> turn -> walk
demos.blurb: RUN: bash projects/policies/demos/run_walk_turn_walk.sh  — walks ~5 m, turns a real ~90 deg by FOOTWORK (no crane yaw; lands 90.6-95.6 deg actual), then a clean straight leg on the new heading. 3/3, 0 falls. CRANED.

demos.name: G1 footwork turn (solo)
demos.blurb: RUN: bash projects/policies/demos/run_turn_solo.sh  — the footwork-turn policy by itself: settle to a stand, turn ~90 deg on pure footwork (wtz=0), decel, hold. EXPERIMENTAL per the skill registry. CRANED.

demos.name: G1 stair climb + summit stand
demos.blurb: RUN: bash projects/policies/demos/run_climb_stairs_stand.sh  — climbs the full 5 treads (3 cm risers) LEGS-ONLY (HARNESS_KZ=0, no vertical assist), then a position-gated BATON handover holds a verified motionless stand on the top landing. CAP: 3 cm is the measured ceiling (4 cm ~= 2 steps, 5 cm ~= 0).

demos.name: G1 stair climb (5 treads @ 3 cm)
demos.blurb: RUN: bash projects/policies/demos/run_climb_stairs.sh  — real foot steps up 5 treads, LEGS-ONLY (HARNESS_KZ=0), base z 0.72->0.88. Stairs are NOT solved: 3 cm is the measured ceiling for the stock-foot G1 (4 cm ~= 2 steps, 5 cm ~= 0).

demos.name: G1 'decent walker' (flagship walk)
demos.blurb: RUN: powershell -File projects/policies/worlds/run_g1_decent_walker.ps1  — G1 walks the official Unitree gait beside its ghost hologram (WBMATCH4 0.868). CRANED (visible puppet harness). Long straights still have a residual live fall rate.

demos.name: G1 box grasp (physics arms)
demos.blurb: RUN: bash projects/policies/demos/run_box_grasp.sh  — EXPERIMENTAL / BLOCKED (the script says so): G1 picks up a real Newton box with its ARMS, zero kinematic writes. Blocked on a warp contact-kernel defect near the cart. The shipping pick-and-place demo is box delivery.
